title: Jacobian estimates and geometric inequalities under intermediate Ricci curvature
summary: We prove a Jacobian estimate underlying both the Heintze--Karcher comparison and the Alexandrov--Bakelman--Pucci method for submanifolds of arbitrary codimension. The estimate retains the contributions of ambient curvature along geodesics emanating from the submanifold and requires no curvature sign assumption.
